story.高山厚土: a high mountain of deep earth
story.甲木參天，脫胎要火: Jia Wood reaches to the sky; to break free of its shell it needs Fire
story.乙木雖柔，刲羊解牛: Yi Wood is soft, yet it can carve a goat and take apart an ox
story.丙火猛烈，欺霜侮雪: Bing Fire is fierce; it scorns the frost and mocks the snow
story.丁火柔中，內性昭融: Ding Fire is gentle and centred, bright and warm within
story.戊土固重，既中且正: Wu Earth is solid and heavy, both centred and upright
story.己土卑濕，中正蓄藏: Ji Earth lies low and moist, centred and upright, storing and keeping
story.庚金帶煞，剛健為最: Geng Metal carries an edge; firm strength is its best
story.辛金軟弱，溫潤而清: Xin Metal is soft and gentle, warm, smooth and clear
story.壬水通河，能洩金氣: Ren Water joins the rivers and can draw off the force of Metal
story.癸水至弱，達於天津: Gui Water is the weakest of all, yet it reaches the heavenly ford
story.正直上進、有原則，像大樹一心往上長，做事有規畫、肯承擔，帶著天生的領導架勢: upright, ambitious and principled; like a great tree set on growing upwards, you plan your work, take on responsibility and carry a natural air of leadership
story.自尊心強、不太會轉彎，面子拉不下來時容易硬撐，受挫時寧折不彎: your pride is strong and you do not bend easily; when you cannot lose face you tend to hold out, and under setbacks you would rather break than bow
story.柔中帶韌、善解人意，像藤蔓一樣懂得借力使力，適應力強，人際手腕細膩: soft but resilient and understanding; like a vine you know how to use the strength around you, you adapt well and handle people with a delicate touch
story.容易猶豫、顧慮多，太在意別人的看法，有時依賴心偏重: you can hesitate and worry a lot, care too much what others think, and sometimes lean on others more than you need to
story.熱情開朗、光明磊落，喜歡照顧人，有感染力與表現欲，做事積極、不藏私: warm, cheerful and open-hearted; you like looking after people, your energy is catching, you enjoy being seen and you work with drive and generosity
story.性子急、容易三分鐘熱度，愛面子，話說得太直時容易得罪人: you are impatient, your enthusiasm can burn out quickly, you care about face, and speaking too bluntly can offend people
story.外柔內明，細心體貼、思慮周密，觀察力敏銳，對認定的人和事很長情: gentle outside and clear within; thoughtful, considerate and careful, a sharp observer, and deeply loyal to the people and things you choose
story.心思重、情緒起伏較大，容易多慮而消耗自己: you think heavily, your moods rise and fall, and worrying too much can wear you out
story.穩重踏實、守信用，包容力強，給人可靠的安全感，做事重實際: steady, down-to-earth and true to your word; you are tolerant, people feel safe relying on you, and you value what is practical
story.固執保守、變通較慢，不輕易表露情緒，有時讓人覺得難以親近: you can be stubborn and cautious, slow to change course, and you rarely show your feelings, which can make you seem hard to approach
story.溫和謙虛、心思細密，善於包容與培育別人，默默付出、重視家庭: gentle, modest and attentive to detail; you are good at accepting and nurturing others, give quietly and put family first
story.容易想太多、優柔寡斷，常委屈自己去成全別人: you can overthink and dither, and often put yourself last so that others can have their way
story.剛毅果斷、講義氣，行動力強，重承諾、敢做敢當，有正義感: resolute and decisive, fiercely loyal and quick to act; you keep your promises, own what you do and have a strong sense of justice
story.脾氣硬、說話衝，好勝心強，不喜歡被管: your temper is hard and your words sharp, you hate to lose and you dislike being told what to do
story.細膩敏銳、重品味與質感，做事追求精緻完美，外表溫潤而內心自有原則: sensitive and perceptive, with an eye for taste and quality; you aim for refinement in what you do, gentle on the surface with firm principles inside
story.愛面子、對批評敏感，很在意別人的評價，壓力大時容易鑽牛角尖: you care about face, are sensitive to criticism and to what others think, and under pressure you can get stuck going round in circles
story.聰明機智、反應快、心胸開闊，喜歡自由與變化，有謀略也有包容力: clever and quick-witted, broad-minded, fond of freedom and change, a good strategist with room for others
story.定性不足、容易隨性而為，想法多變，有時讓人捉摸不定: you can lack staying power, act on a whim and change your mind often, which can leave people unsure where they stand
story.溫柔細膩、想像力豐富、直覺敏銳，善於體察人心，做事低調而有韌性: gentle and sensitive, imaginative and intuitive; you read people well and work quietly with real perseverance
story.容易多愁善感、缺乏安全感，想得多而行動遲疑: you can be moody and insecure, thinking a great deal and acting slowly
story.脫胎要火: to break free of its shell it needs Fire
story.甲木要有火來發揮，就像木材遇火才見光彩: Jia Wood needs Fire to show what it can do, as timber only shines once it meets the flame
story.地潤天和，植立千古: with moist ground and a gentle sky it stands for a thousand years
story.地支有水滋潤、天干和順，大樹才能長久挺立: with Water in the branches to keep it moist and harmony in the stems, the great tree can stand tall for a long time
story.懷丁抱丙，跨鳳乘猴: holding Ding and embracing Bing, it rides the Rooster and the Monkey
story.乙木有丙丁火相伴，就不怕申酉金來剋: with Bing and Ding Fire beside it, Yi Wood need not fear the Metal of Shen and You
story.藤蘿繫甲，可春可秋: a vine tied to Jia thrives in spring and autumn alike
story.藤蘿攀上大樹，四季都能生長，喜歡有同類扶持: a vine that climbs a great tree grows in every season; it likes the support of its own kind
story.虛濕之地，騎馬亦憂: on empty, damp ground, even riding the Horse brings worry
story.水多地濕，乙木的根容易爛，即使有火也難以發揮: with too much Water the ground is soggy and Yi Wood's roots rot easily; even Fire then struggles to help
story.虎馬犬鄉，甲來成滅: in the land of Tiger, Horse and Dog, Jia arriving brings destruction
story.火勢已旺時再添甲木，只會燒得太烈: adding Jia Wood when the Fire is already strong only makes it burn too fiercely
story.水猖顯節: when Water rages, it shows its integrity
story.水勢再大，丙火也能顯出光明的節氣: however strong the Water, Bing Fire can still show its bright, upright spirit
story.如有嫡母，可秋可冬: with a true mother, it can face autumn and winter
story.有甲木（正印）生扶，生在秋冬也不怕: with Jia Wood (the Nurturer) to feed it, it need not fear an autumn or winter birth
story.水潤物生，火燥物病: moistened by Water, all things grow; dried by Fire, all things sicken
story.厚土要有水滋潤才能長養萬物，火太燥則土乾: deep earth needs Water to nourish all things; with too much Fire it dries out
story.若要物旺，宜助宜幫: to make things flourish, it needs help and support
story.己土要生養萬物，需要火與同類的土來幫扶: for Ji Earth to raise all things, it needs Fire and the help of its own kind, Earth
story.得水而清，得火而銳: with Water it becomes clear; with Fire it becomes sharp
story.庚金遇水洩秀就清，遇火鍛鍊就利: Geng Metal turns clear when Water draws out its talent, and sharp when Fire forges it
story.土潤則生，土乾則脆: moist earth gives it life; dry earth makes it brittle
story.濕潤的土能生金，乾燥的土反而讓金變脆: moist earth feeds Metal, while dry earth only makes Metal brittle
story.畏土之疊，樂水之盈: it fears piles of earth and delights in plentiful water
story.怕厚土把它埋住，喜歡水來淘洗，越洗越亮: it fears being buried under thick earth and loves Water to wash it: the more it is washed, the brighter it shines
story.熱則喜母，寒則喜丁: in heat it wants its mother; in cold it wants Ding
story.生在熱天喜歡土（印）來滋養，生在冷天喜歡丁火來暖: born in hot weather it likes Earth (its Nurturer) to nourish it; born in cold weather it likes Ding Fire to warm it
story.通根透癸，沖天奔地: rooted and showing Gui, it surges to the sky and races over the land
story.壬水通根又見癸水時氣勢奔騰，需要疏導而不宜再添: when Ren Water is rooted and Gui Water shows too, its force races ahead: it needs channelling, not more Water
story.化則有情，從則相濟: transformed it is warm-hearted; following, it helps the others along
story.壬水能合能從，順勢而行時最見智慧: Ren Water can combine and can follow; it shows its wisdom best when it goes with the flow
story.得龍而運，功化斯神: with the Dragon it moves, and its work becomes wondrous
story.癸水遇辰（龍）就能興雲化雨，發揮最大的作用: when Gui Water meets Chen (the Dragon) it can raise clouds and bring rain, doing the most good
story.不愁火土，不論庚辛: it does not worry about Fire or Earth, nor depend on Geng or Xin
story.癸水看似柔弱，其實不怕火土，也不一定要庚辛來生: Gui Water looks weak but does not fear Fire or Earth, and does not necessarily need Geng or Xin Metal to feed it
story.木賴水生，水多木漂: Wood relies on Water to grow, but too much Water sets the Wood adrift
story.火賴木生，木多火熾: Fire relies on Wood to grow, but too much Wood makes the Fire blaze
story.土賴火生，火多土焦: Earth relies on Fire to grow, but too much Fire scorches the Earth
story.金賴土生，土多金埋: Metal relies on Earth to grow, but too much Earth buries the Metal
story.水賴金生，金多水濁: Water relies on Metal to grow, but too much Metal muddies the Water
story.木能生火，火多木焚: Wood can feed Fire, but too much Fire burns the Wood away
story.火能生土，土多火晦: Fire can feed Earth, but too much Earth dims the Fire
story.土能生金，金多土變: Earth can feed Metal, but too much Metal wears the Earth down
story.金能生水，水多金沉: Metal can feed Water, but too much Water sinks the Metal
story.水能生木，木盛水縮: Water can feed Wood, but too much Wood shrinks the Water
story.木能剋土，土重木折: Wood can control Earth, but too much Earth breaks the Wood
story.火能剋金，金多火熄: Fire can control Metal, but too much Metal puts the Fire out
story.土能剋水，水多土流: Earth can control Water, but too much Water washes the Earth away
story.金能剋木，木堅金缺: Metal can control Wood, but Wood too hard chips the Metal
story.水能剋火，火炎水灼: Water can control Fire, but Fire too fierce boils the Water away
story.木弱逢金，必為砍折: weak Wood that meets Metal is sure to be cut down
story.火弱逢水，必為熄滅: weak Fire that meets Water is sure to be put out
story.土衰逢木，必遭傾陷: weak Earth that meets Wood is sure to cave in
story.金衰遇火，必見銷鎔: weak Metal that meets Fire is sure to melt
story.水弱逢土，必為淤塞: weak Water that meets Earth is sure to silt up
story.強木得火，方化其頑: strong Wood needs Fire to soften its stubbornness
story.強火得土，方止其焰: strong Fire needs Earth to calm its flames
story.強土得金，方制其壅: strong Earth needs Metal to clear its blockage
story.強金得水，方挫其鋒: strong Metal needs Water to blunt its edge
story.強水得木，方洩其勢: strong Water needs Wood to drain off its force

story.心直口快、不服管，對人對己要求都高: outspoken, resistant to control, and demanding of yourself and others

story.保守、計較得失，有時放不開: cautious and careful about gains and losses, and sometimes unable to let go
story.重視物質與安全感，容易為錢操心: you value material security and can worry about money
story.重視家庭與實際，生活有條理: family-minded and practical, with an orderly life
story.穩定經營、管帳管物的工作: steady work running things, managing accounts or goods
story.日主所剋、同陰陽: the element the Day Master controls, the same polarity

story.花錢快、愛冒險，容易財來財去: quick to spend and fond of risk, so money comes and goes

story.豪爽好客，對機會敏感: open-handed and hospitable, with a nose for opportunity
story.剋日主、異陰陽: the element that controls the Day Master, the opposite polarity

story.自我要求高，重視形象: you demand a lot of yourself and care about your image
story.剋日主、同陰陽: the element that controls the Day Master, the same polarity

story.外柔內剛，有危機意識: soft outside and tough inside, alert to danger
story.有挑戰、要決斷的工作: challenging work that calls for decisions
story.生日主、異陰陽: the element that feeds the Day Master, the opposite polarity

story.依賴心較重、被動，想得多做得少: rather dependent and passive, thinking more than doing
story.容易保守、依賴，行動力不足: liable to be cautious and dependent, short on drive
story.心地仁厚，需要安全感: kind-hearted, with a need for security
story.學術、教育與需要專業背書的工作: academic work, teaching, and work that needs professional credentials

story.內心有獨特的想法，需要獨處的空間: a mind full of unusual ideas, which needs time alone

story.身強任財、食傷生財: a strong Day Master carrying its Wealth, and the Creator and Rebel feeding Wealth
story.月令本氣是正印: the main qi of the month branch is the Nurturer
story.仁厚好學、重精神與名聲，有長者風範: kind and studious, valuing the spirit and a good name, with the bearing of an elder
story.月令本氣是偏印: the main qi of the month branch is the Maverick

story.月令本氣是食神: the main qi of the month branch is the Creator

story.日主極弱又沒有根，順從旺的一方: the Day Master is extremely weak and has no roots, so it goes along with the strongest side
story.日主極旺，順著它的氣勢: the Day Master is extremely strong, so go with its force
story.日主偏強，喜歡被洩、被耗、被剋: the Day Master leans strong, and likes to be drained, spent and controlled
story.日主偏弱，喜歡被生、被幫: the Day Master leans weak, and likes to be fed and backed up
story.日主強弱適中，只有輕微偏好: the Day Master is of moderate strength, with only mild preferences
story.順從食傷，喜財星流通；最怕印星奪食，也不喜官殺: it follows the Creator and Rebel and likes Wealth to keep things flowing; it fears the Nurturer and Maverick stars stealing the food most, and dislikes Authority and Challenger too
story.順從財星，喜食傷生財；最怕比劫奪財、印星生身: it follows the Wealth stars and likes the Creator and Rebel to feed Wealth; it fears Peers and Rivals taking the Wealth, and the Nurturer and Maverick stars feeding the Day Master
story.順從官殺，喜財星生殺；最怕食傷制殺、印比扶身: it follows Authority and Challenger and likes Wealth to feed them; it fears the Creator and Rebel taming the Challenger, and Nurturer and Maverick stars or Peers propping the Day Master up
story.食傷、財、官殺都有勢力而不從一神，宜行財運居中調和；最怕印比扶身: the Creator and Rebel, Wealth, and Authority and Challenger are all strong and none leads, so luck in Wealth makes peace between them; it fears Nurturer and Maverick stars or Peers propping the Day Master up
story.食傷與官殺相持而財星不足，宜行財運通關調和；最怕印比扶身: the Creator and Rebel stand off against Authority and Challenger with too little Wealth, so luck in Wealth bridges them; it fears Nurturer and Maverick stars or Peers propping the Day Master up
story.順從財星，財官相生；最怕比劫奪財、印星生身: it follows the Wealth stars, with Wealth and Authority feeding each other; it fears Peers and Rivals taking the Wealth, and the Nurturer and Maverick stars feeding the Day Master
story.印星與比劫成勢，順其強勢，喜比劫、印星；最怕財星壞印、官殺觸怒，也不宜食傷洩氣: the Nurturer and Maverick stars and Peers and Rivals are in command, so go with that strength, liking Peers and Nurturer and Maverick stars; it fears Wealth spoiling the Nurturer and Authority and Challenger provoking it, and does not want the Creator and Rebel draining it either
story.順其旺氣、喜食傷洩秀；最怕官殺逆勢剋制: go with its dominant energy, liking the Creator and Rebel to let its talent out; it fears Authority and Challenger fighting against it

story.生在夏天，命局偏燥，: Born in summer, the chart runs hot and dry.
